description: Controlled single-seed 50000-round Task 2 reward-structure experiment against the matching V3.4 50000-round baseline. V3.5 keeps the feature representation, action space, learning-rate schedule, epsilon schedule, discount factor, checkpoint interval, seeds, and evaluation protocol unchanged. Safe directional movements in single-objective states use fixed +0.040 adherence and -0.040 non-adherence; safe directional movements in joint-target states use +0.040 for following both, 0 for following exactly one, and -0.040 for following neither. Only true conflicts use the independent class strengths through 0.5 * 0.040 * ((2C-1)s_coin + (2B-1)s_bomb). A usable bomb target on the current tile suppresses navigation shaping: a successful BOMB receives +0.10 before the unchanged -0.02 bomb cost, while every non-BOMB action receives -0.20. Any Movement/WAIT action outside the safety mask receives -0.50 when a safe alternative exists, independent of threat urgency; no safety penalty is added when no safe alternative exists. The terminal self-kill penalty is -1.0. All remaining event rewards are unchanged from V3.4.
